title: Siegard concept frontmatter
description: Frontmatter contract for a concept file in a Siegard concept bundle. Derived from Google's Open Knowledge Format v0.2: OKF field names and semantics are preserved where they coincide, and Siegard adds required fields OKF leaves optional. See the OKF-derived concept decision, including the one documented divergence on `status`.

id.description: Stable identifier. Siegard addition: OKF has no identifier field.

type.description: OKF field. OKF leaves type values unregistered; Siegard closes the vocabulary so a consumer branches on a known value. Extend this enum only when a second type actually exists.

status.description: Siegard lifecycle vocabulary, shared with the decision-record format. DIVERGES from OKF, which defines draft|stable|deprecated on this field. Documented in ADR-0005.

contract_version.description: Siegard addition. A consumer rejects an artifact it was not built to read rather than inferring version from shape.

generated.description: OKF trust field. Siegard requires it; OKF leaves it optional.

verified.description: OKF trust field. Verification events, most recent last.

sources.description: OKF provenance field. Materials this concept derives from. Siegard requires resource to be a repo-relative path or an absolute URI.

resource.description: OKF field. Canonical location of the asset this concept describes, when one exists outside the bundle.

stale_after.description: OKF lifecycle field. Date after which content should be re-verified.
